description_en: Retrieves the field list of automated response rules
description_zh: 获取自动化响应规则字段列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-response-rule-fields --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResponseRuleFields

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that marks the position from which to start reading. Leave this parameter empty to read from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

ListResponseRuleFields.description_en: The list of response rule fields

DataType.description_en: The data type of the automated response rule condition field
DataType.description_zh: 自动化响应规则条件字段数据类型

FieldName.description_en: The name of the rule field

FieldNormalization.description_en: The normalization object type to which the field belongs
FieldNormalization.description_zh: 字段所属归一化对象类型

RightValue.description_en: The list of optional enumeration values for the field. This parameter is not returned if no enumeration values are available
RightValue.description_zh: 字段可选枚举值列表，无枚举不返回

ValueName.description_en: The display name of the enumeration value

SupportOperators.description_en: The English descriptions of the operators

items.description_en: The English descriptions of the operators

HasRightValue.description_en:
Indicates whether a right-side value is required. Valid values:
true: Required.
false: Not required
HasRightValue.description_zh:
是否需要右值。取值：
true：需要
false：不需要

Index.description_en: The position of the operator in the operator list
Index.description_zh: 操作符所处操作符列表位置

Operator.description_en:
The aggregation method for the dispatch rule condition. Valid values:

`=`: equal to
`<>`: not equal to
`in`: contains
`not in`: does not contain
`REGEXP`: matches the regular expression
`NOT REGEXP`: does not match the regular expression
Operator.description_zh:
分派规则条件聚合方式。

`=`：等于
`<>`：不等于
`in`：包含
`not in`：不包含
`REGEXP`：匹配正则
`NOT REGEXP`：正则不匹配

OperatorName.description_en: The display name of the operator

SupportDataType.description_en: The data types supported by the current operator, separated by commas
SupportDataType.description_zh: 当前操作符可以支持的数据类型，以逗号分隔

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. Valid values: leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
